# App Banton Studios

> A design and build studio in Port of Spain, Trinidad. Three disciplines under one roof: marketing (film, photography and social posts), software (websites, web apps and mobile apps) and construction (residential design, build and renovation).

The same studio made the house, the film and the website for Skylark Villa, a private villa on Trinidad's northern coast.

## Marketing (https://appbanton.com/marketing)

Film, photography and social posts.

- **The Longest Hour**: a film made for Skylark Villa. Watch: https://youtu.be/BmJ1-GopThM
- **The Road Never Stops**: a film in production. Release date to be announced.

## Software (https://appbanton.com/software)

Websites, web apps and mobile apps. Live projects:

- **ShadowGovTT** (https://shadowgovtt.com): Trinidad and Tobago government services redesigned for the people who use them. Existing forms, portals and websites rebuilt as usable alternatives.
- **Skylark Villa** (https://theskylarkvilla.com): website for a luxury villa on Trinidad's northern coast, built to convert the right guest.
- **Literead** (https://literead.co): an AI reading coach for children. A patient voice coach that asks the right questions after every passage.
- **Cobaderos** (https://cobaderos.com): a monetisation layer for revocable digital credentials under EUDI. An auditable, issuer-facing signal of verification activity that can support commercial billing without breaching the Architecture Reference Framework's privacy prohibitions.

## Construction (https://appbanton.com/construction)

Residential design, build and renovation, in Trinidad. Each project has a photo gallery.

- **Blanchisseuse** (https://appbanton.com/construction/skylark-villa): new build, 16 months. The private villa on the north coast that is also Skylark Villa. Footings and retaining walls on a sloping site, a framed structure over two levels, four flights of stairs, a carport and driveway.
- **Cascade** (https://appbanton.com/construction/cascade): renovation, 5 months. French drain, stairs up a 15 ft slope, security door, masonry and plumbing, and a bridge to a renovated bedroom.
- **San Juan** (https://appbanton.com/construction/san-juan): renovation, 7 weeks. Bathroom, kitchen and living room renovated, including new ceilings, tile, a glass shower enclosure and a solid wood sliding door.
